note: Blue Earth County park on the SE shore of Madison Lake (~1,347 acres), about 2 miles SE of the city of Madison Lake. Wooded sites; fishing dock, boat landing, swim beach, kayak/SUP rentals, nature trail with a swinging bridge, and a log cabin interpretive center. Gates are generally open in daylight. --Claude
summary: Read via headless browser (Cloudflare blocks plain HTTP): county facility + reservations pages and the ResNexus engine. Booking -> operator (ResNexus) url, opens March 1; season 05-01..10-31; 30A electric (site 1), water at some sites; dump, drinking water. No nightly rate published anywhere official (engine shows none out of season). Not waterfront kept.
flags: RATE UNREAD: no official nightly rate found. The county pages post none, the ResNexus engine shows no prices for November dates (all sites UNAVAILABLE, 2027 booking opens March 1), and the 2012 brochure has none. Only aggregator figure: Campendium 'Last Nightly Rate $45, reported 6/9/25' (corroboration only, not written). RV Life $$ tier stands.

SITES: the engine lists at least 25 'RV Back In' sites plus Tent Sites (the 'SHOW MORE' list did not expand headless); the 2012 county guide's table gives Bray 33 mobile camping sites and 10 tent sites. Count left unset (2012 is stale and the engine count is incomplete). Site 1 'Up To 45ft', Motorhome allowed.

COUNTY PAGE: 'A sign up/log in will be required to preview reservation options and check availability' - in practice the ResNexus site list and site details load without a login; prices/booking may need an account. Not a login wall for presence (local campground).

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the camping area sits under continuous canopy east of the shore road; the lake is ~55-65 m from the open pads through trees (Esri, around 44.1810,-93.7918). A filtered lakeview from a few sites is possible but no site photo or map shows it.
Pin 44.1810,-93.7918 sits in the wooded camping area; no move. Phone 507-243-3885 (park office) and website confirmed.
